## NEWEST: 2026-08-31 (was 2026-08-28 on the 08-30 scan).

2026-08-31 *** FEDERATED DATA STORES IN ASSURED WORKLOADS (GA) *** REPORTED 09-02 MEDIUM/AISPM
  Google Workspace and third-party FEDERATED data stores can now be connected to projects inside
  **Assured Workloads folders**, which enforce **FedRAMP High**.
  Third-party federated connectors at GA or Public Preview are IN SCOPE for Google's FedRAMP High
  authorization; so is the Google federated connector for Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Calendar).
  Authorized (indexed) data stores for FedRAMP High / IL4 are Cloud Storage buckets + BigQuery datasets.
  >>> MECHANISM IS THE FINDING: a FEDERATED store is NOT INDEXED. "Gemini Enterprise sends your
      search query DIRECTLY TO THE THIRD-PARTY API" and blends the results. So an agent inside a
      FedRAMP High boundary issues LIVE QUERIES OUT to third-party SaaS APIs at request time.
      The compliance boundary and the data-flow boundary are NOT the same boundary.
      => record FEDERATION MODE as an attribute of every data store.
2026-08-31 *** SENSITIVE DATA PROTECTION CONTENT POLICIES (GA) *** REPORTED 09-02 (same finding)
  SDP content policies can now be applied to **connectors, apps AND notebooks**; blocks sensitive or
  inappropriate material. => its ABSENCE is now a detectable posture gap at three object levels.
2026-08-31 Gemini 3.5 Flash in Canada (ca) with in-region DRZ + MLP.  [held]
2026-08-31 Gemini 3.1 Flash Image "Nano Banana 2" GA in us and eu multi-regions.  [held]

2026-08-28 Five new data stores in public preview: Campfire, Clay, CourtListener, Daloopa, MSCI.
2026-08-28 New ACTIONS on existing connectors: AirOps "Update knowledge base document metadata";
  Airtable "Create records for a table"; Zoho Desk "Update event".
  [both reported 2026-08-30 MEDIUM/AISPM — the read-to-write drift pattern]
2026-08-26 A2UI Material catalog component updates v0.9.  [held]
2026-08-24 D&B Commercial Graph data store (public preview).  [held / prior scan]
2026-08-24 Cloud Monitoring: new request-count dimensions tool_id, engine_id, response_code, and a new
  TOOL-INVOCATION LATENCY metric (beta).  [held — but note: tool_id on request metrics is an ingestible
  per-tool activity signal]

## STANDING PATTERN (3rd scan): Google keeps widening what ALREADY-CONNECTED data stores can do —
## new actions, new compliance placements, new policy attach points — WITHOUT the connector list
## changing. An inventory taken before the change understates reach afterward.
